intended_pipeline: USA audience; English; one ~6-minute long video and one related Short per day, pending full end-to-end proof.
evidence_boundary: This catalog maps checked-in workflow configuration and tool responsibilities. A listed step, tool or passing static test does not prove that the real provider request, voice, final MP4, remote storage or YouTube schedule succeeded.

runtime_monitoring.failure_event_trigger: workflow_run completed failure for the allowlisted monitored workflows
runtime_monitoring.availability_caveat: GitHub Actions cron is periodic best-effort, not a continuously running daemon or a 24/7 uptime guarantee. Use workflow_dispatch for an immediate check. A missed schedule or unavailable GitHub Actions service can delay detection.

health_probe_endpoints.meaning: HTTP/service health endpoint reachability; not evidence that content generation works.
HTTP/service health endpoint reachability; not evidence that the production renderer completed.
HTTP/service health endpoint reachability; not evidence that a D1 write or duplicate guard passed.

decision_rules: If active run is within its timeout and required gate is progressing, report active/in_progress; do not start a duplicate run.
If completed success and required artifacts/QA readback exist, continue to the next configured stage only through its existing workflow trigger.
If completed failure, retrieve the authentic failed-job log, classify with deterministic rules plus ML diagnostics, and follow only a documented bounded recovery that matches the evidence.

If provider quota/rate limit, missing credential, state ambiguity, unsupported claim, missing media or unknown incident: preserve state, block the dependent/release stage and record unresolved evidence.
If a repair changes code, require focused tests and relevant CI/static validation; if any gate fails, do not merge/release and preserve the failure report.
ML cannot authorize arbitrary code edits, workflow/Worker deployments, secrets/billing changes, publishing, duplicate upload attempts, or quality-gate overrides.
After a successful validated stage, continue only through the existing idempotent workflow chain; never infer that a failed workflow succeeded from the model prediction.

stages.name: Monitoring and incident diagnosis
stages.purpose: Read GitHub Actions state, inspect bounded failure logs, probe configured Workers and preserve a sanitized incident report.

stages.name: Research and source evidence
stages.purpose: Collect approved research context and topic candidates; retain URLs/evidence; avoid claiming a topic is trending without sufficient corroboration.
quality_gates: Tavily stays disabled when its quota is exhausted

stages.name: Trend selection and editorial rotation
stages.purpose: Select the scheduled category or a sufficiently evidenced live trend; distinguish evergreen fallback from a verified current trend.
quality_gates: at least three unique relevant video IDs for live-trend mode

stages.name: Original script and factual audit
stages.purpose: Generate source-supported narration and title/description/tags; check spoken word count and independent voice/factual audit.
quality_gates: hook score and human voice score meet configured threshold

stages.name: Content package and durable handoff
stages.purpose: Convert a validated research artifact into a handoff request, preserve job state and prevent processing/uploading a duplicate package.

stages.name: Automatic narration and captions
stages.purpose: Generate narration with the configured Kokoro pipeline, edit timing, create captions and reject silent/missing/invalid audio before scene timing.
quality_gates: caption and final voice timing align

stages.name: Licensed media and source-linked graphics
stages.purpose: Discover and validate licensed, relevant footage/stills; create branded graphics, evidence-backed charts and overlays; persist attribution and reject reused/prohibited assets.
quality_gates: exact asset license and attribution verified

stages.name: Voice-aligned scene plan and visual budget
stages.purpose: Map narration timestamps to scenes and ensure the actual sequence meets visual variety, cadence, captions and overlay-budget requirements.
quality_gates: final voice timestamps drive scene timing
visual element budget validated on actual render
no synthetic budget report treated as final media evidence

stages.name: FFmpeg rendering and finishing
stages.purpose: Render and compose scenes, transition effects, music and optional 3D output; validate the produced media rather than trusting a green command alone.
quality_gates: narration and music do not clip
partial MP4 never treated as complete

stages.name: Rendered-content QA and metadata
stages.purpose: Review the finished video's narration, caption synchronization, visual relevance, thumbnail and SEO metadata; block critical failures.

stages.name: Related Short production
stages.purpose: Create a separate vertical Short from the verified content package, and independently check duration, dimensions, caption coverage, narration and originality.

stages.name: Upload and scheduled publication
stages.purpose: Check for existing uploads, upload through YouTube Data API, apply thumbnail and schedule, then read back remote video ID, privacyStatus and publishAt.
quality_gates: no upload before all critical QA passes

stages.name: Storage, delivery manifest and learning loop
stages.purpose: Persist sanitized reports, verified media/provenance metadata and post-delivery observations for later review.
quality_gates: local artifact is retained until safe cleanup
storage readback/checksum verified before success claim

stages.name: YouTube performance analytics
stages.purpose: Read uploaded video performance and feed measured outcomes into content planning only after authentic Analytics API data is available.

incident_routes.label: AUDIO_QA_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Keep release blocked; validate the narration file, decode, measurable audio signal, duration, sample rate and caption alignment; regenerate only through an existing bounded workflow.

incident_routes.label: ASSET_LICENSE_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Quarantine the asset and replace it only with a source whose exact allowed license and attribution are verified.

incident_routes.label: CAPTION_SYNC_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Regenerate captions from final voice timestamps; check cue order and audio duration before scene rendering/release.

incident_routes.label: CODE_SYNTAX_OR_IMPORT_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Identify one allowlisted helper from the real traceback; minimal patch only if current controller selects a unique permitted file; compile and focused test; otherwise unresolved issue.

incident_routes.label: CONTENT_DEDUP_STATE_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Stop handoff/upload until content hash, stored state and remote publication lookup are read back and consistent.

incident_routes.label: CREDENTIAL_CONFIG_MISSING
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Stop affected provider work; identify missing secret name only, never print/fabricate secret; authorized repository owner configures it.

incident_routes.label: D1_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Stop repeated D1 probes/writes until reset; do not claim durable state/dedup succeeded without readback.

incident_routes.label: DEPENDENCY_INSTALL_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Compare pinned dependency/runtime and exact install log; bounded network retry if transient; do not blindly upgrade dependencies.

incident_routes.label: DISK_SPACE_EXHAUSTED
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Inspect known temporary workspace only; clean only clearly disposable artifacts after preserving sources/checkpoints; then run integrity checks.

incident_routes.label: DUPLICATE_UPLOAD_RISK
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Block new insert while upload state is uncertain; verify the matching content hash/idempotency key and existing remote video ID.

incident_routes.label: GROQ_RATE_LIMITED
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Honor actual provider reset evidence; at most one bounded retry when reset/wait fits timeout; avoid exhausting Workers AI fallback and never enable paid billing.

incident_routes.label: JSON_SCHEMA_PARSE_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Capture a sanitized parse error; allow at most one bounded schema-constrained repair; reject malformed output if validation still fails.

incident_routes.label: MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Reject empty/truncated/placeholder output; one bounded evidence-preserving generation retry only when provider capacity is available; otherwise stop.

incident_routes.label: QUEUE_JOB_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Check attempt counter, idempotency and dead-letter evidence; bounded retry only for transient errors; quarantine uncertain messages.

incident_routes.label: RENDER_TIMEOUT
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Preserve render checkpoints and logs, inspect slow stage and use only configured timeout/retry policy; never accept partial output.

incident_routes.label: SCHEDULE_READBACK_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Keep uploaded video private; verify video ID, privacyStatus and publishAt; do not report scheduling as complete without exact readback.

incident_routes.label: SCRIPT_AUDIT_BLOCK
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Inspect audit artifact and claims; repair the draft against sources if safe; explicit rejection, weak score or unknown unsupported claims remains blocking.

incident_routes.label: SCRIPT_LENGTH_GATE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Use no more than one evidence-locked rewrite under existing contract, recount spoken words, and block if still outside 850-1000.

incident_routes.label: SOURCE_CLAIM_MISMATCH
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Remove or rewrite the precise unsupported claim using retained credible evidence; keep source/citation QA blocking until rechecked.

incident_routes.label: SUPABASE_STORAGE_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Retain the local verified artifact; bounded retry only for transient faults; verify remote key, size and checksum before marking storage successful.

incident_routes.label: TAVILY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Observe configured Tavily cooldown and stay on approved alternative sources; do not retry Tavily while quota is exhausted.

incident_routes.label: TEST_REGRESSION_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Keep the failing test; locate the first regression and patch only an allowed file with a demonstrated root cause; rerun focused and CI tests before merge.

incident_routes.label: TRANSIENT_NETWORK_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Use configured finite retry/backoff for recognized transient network failures only; keep state idempotent and stop after limit.

incident_routes.label: TREND_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Do not claim a live trend without the configured evidence minimum; use the scheduled evergreen fallback only when its explicit validator contract passes.

incident_routes.label: VIDEO_INTEGRITY_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Keep upload blocked; run ffprobe/decode/duration/resolution/frame-rate checks on the actual MP4; rerender only when source/checkpoint is safe.

incident_routes.label: WORKERS_AI_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Stop Worker inference until free quota reset; do not loop the fallback or enable paid billing; preserve the script job as blocked.

incident_routes.label: WORKER_DEPLOYMENT_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Keep traffic unchanged; read back active Worker version/bindings and retain known-good rollback candidate. Production Worker code/deploy is protected from ML-authorized fixes.

incident_routes.label: WORKFLOW_CONFIG_INVALID
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Validate workflow YAML/actionlint and inspect exact step/triggers/permissions; workflows are protected and changes require normal PR CI.

incident_routes.label: YOUTUBE_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Stop API retries until quota resets; do not enable billing or claim upload/schedule success.

incident_routes.label: YOUTUBE_UPLOAD_FAILURE
incident_routes.permitted_recovery: Check resumable-session/remote video readback before retry; never create a second video when remote upload state is unknown.

protected_operations: Cloudflare Worker source/bindings/deployments and production traffic shifts
database schema migrations or destructive D1 data operations
billing or switching to paid services
YouTube upload, privacy/publication/schedule actions, or thumbnail/metadata mutation after a release block
any reduction or bypass of factual, narration, media-license, visual-budget, audio, caption or rendered-video QA gates
tool_role_policy: Tool descriptions state intended responsibility inferred from registered code/workflows; actual runtime invocation and successful outputs must be proven by logs/artifacts.
